reports.title: Edgewell Personal Care Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results

desk.headline: Sales up 3% to $484.1m, adjusted EPS of $0.78 slightly beats; fiscal 2027 outlook of $1.85–2.15 adjusted EPS
results: Quarterly sales rose 3.0% to $484.1m (3.1% organic), with growth in both North America (+3.3%) and International (+3.0%).
Adjusted gross margin jumped 5.1 points to 45.7% on cost savings and easier comparisons, despite higher costs including tariffs.
Adjusted EPS rose 50% to $0.78; GAAP EPS was $0.23 after $29.9m of restructuring costs.
Sun and Skin Care sales grew 7.0% on strong grooming; Wet Shave grew 1.2% despite private-label supply limits.
For the full year, sales rose 1.8% to $2.0bn and adjusted EPS rose to $1.93; the quarterly dividend stays at $0.15.

guidance.summary: Edgewell gave its first fiscal 2027 outlook: organic sales growth of 1–3%, adjusted EPS of $1.85–2.15 and adjusted EBITDA of $250–270m. It expects about $55m of restructuring charges.

watch: Whether organic growth holds at 1–3% as Edgewell spends more on advertising (about 0.8 points more of sales).
Progress on the planned 0.7-point rise in adjusted operating margin and on restructuring costs of about $55m.
Debt reduction: adjusted net debt was 3.4 times EBITDA at year end.
